brief.scope: Review the final git-refs monitor deliverable at this pinned ref, diff from origin/dev. Apply in/code-review-threshold.md and monitor-only-scope.md. Scope: literal branch/remote params, bounded shared local+remote deadline, strict OIDs/full refs, missing versus unavailable, state/source separation, existing conditions/queue/dedup, documented example. Tests are independently authored; verified red/green receipt is supplied. No onboarding, hooks, branch discovery/recovery, monitor lifecycle or activation. Report only reproducible/reachable in-scope failures with existing requirement, trigger, actual result and attempted refutation; separate unproven/expansion so suggestions do not become conditions. No source edits. Batch findings against this candidate; do not demand additional test inventory without a demonstrated missed failure. Audit security when job is security-audit, behavior/couplings when adversarial-review.

envelope.note:
Security audit of the git-refs monitor deliverable at 91fdaba vs 20f9bca (diff in context/diff.patch). Scope per code-review-threshold.md and monitor-only-scope.md: git-refs adapter + registry example + contract only; onboarding/branch-recovery/lifecycle/activation excluded and not treated as conditions. In-scope changes reviewed: monitor.py (_branch_name, _git_refs_params, _bounded_process deadline/reject_stderr, _git_ref_rows, read_git_refs, _git_source_directories, _validate_state hook), monitor-lever.md amendment + example config, and ruff.toml comment. Result: zero reproducible in-scope security defects; verdict approve.

Categories looked at and found clean (each is 0 findings, not unexamined):
1. argv/shell/SQL/template injection — argv are code-built lists, no shell=True. repo is a resolved absolute path after `-C`; remote regex-validated [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,63} (no leading '-', no ':'/'/' so not coercible to a URL or ext:: transport) and after '--'; branches -> refs/heads/<name> validated by _branch_name (rejects leading '-', control<=32/127, ~^:?*[\\, '..', '@{', '.lock', dot-leading parts) and after '--'. --format literal. SQL uses parameterized queries only (unchanged in this diff). Reproduce: grep -n 'subprocess\|argv\|shell=' ops/conductor/tools/monitor.py; read read_git_refs L710-745.
2. secrets/credentials into tree/record/log — evidence={repo,remote,ref}, metrics={local_oid,remote_oid,freshness}; none are credentials. stderr never surfaced: local reject_stderr returns fixed string 'process reported a read failure'; remote stderr buffered then discarded, only stdout returned; failures become fixed reason strings. Test GIT_SECRET is a synthetic leak assertion; record auth_files entry (.gemini/antigravity-cli/antigravity-oauth-token) is a filename reference, not a value. Reproduce: grep -nEi 'token|secret|password|api[_-]?key|bearer|-----BEGIN|credential' context/diff.patch (12 hits, all benign as above).
3. path/ref escape of snapshot/worktree/job dir — read_git_refs performs no writes; _git_source_directories adds repo, worktree gitdir and commondir to protected set, and _validate_state refuses state overlap. Separation strengthened. Reproduce: read _git_source_directories L834-867 and _validate_state L894-898.
4. permission/sandbox weaker than claimed — doc claims read-only/no-fetch; implementation runs only `git for-each-ref` and `git ls-remote --refs` (both read-only, no hooks, no fetch/checkout/push). S603 ignore pre-existing and documented. Reproduce: read read_git_refs L714-724; diff ruff.toml L4224-4231.
5. trust in vendor output without check — git stdout strictly validated: 40/64 lowercase-hex OID, exact ref names via _branch_name, mandatory trailing newline, exact 2-field tab split, duplicate rejection, plus exit-code and failure gating; empty-successful => missing (found nothing), failure => unavailable (could not look). Reproduce: read _git_ref_rows L684-707 and read_git_refs freshness mapping L726-744.
6. supply-chain surfaces loosened — only a comment changed in ruff.toml; no pins, lockfiles, fetched actions, or dependency changes in the diff. Reproduce: sed -n '4220,4231p' context/diff.patch.

Also confirmed: shared monotonic deadline bounds local+remote total wall time to timeout_s in (0,30]; one ls-remote query covers all branches (no per-branch/per-route fan-out); stdin=DEVNULL plus deadline/kill bounds any auth-prompt hang; validators run for disabled monitors too (no bypass). The added dispatch records under .dev/records are session provenance JSON, no credentials.

Coverage limit (absence declared, not inferred): python3 and git execution were blocked by the session sandbox ('requires approval' on `python3 -c`, `git log`), so I could not dynamically run the adapter or the supplied test suite; verification is static against the pinned tree plus the supplied red/green receipt (monitor-pr-evidence.json: 19 tests, red exit 1 / green exit 0, full suites exit 0). Reproduce commands above are for the reviewer to execute. Per the brief I did not read the git-refs implementation as a mutant target beyond the in-scope diff, and did not demand additional test inventory absent a demonstrated missed failure.
